apps.app_name: SBS On Demand for Android TV

patches.name: Allow sideloaded installation
patches.description: Prevents the Play licensing redirect when launching a sideloaded SBS TV build.

patches.name: Prefer direct VOD stream
patches.description: Prefers an available Akamai VOD stream over Google DAI. Keeps original selection for live or missing alternatives. Ad removal is not guaranteed.

patches.name: Prefer direct live stream
patches.description: Prefers an available Akamai live stream over Google DAI. Broadcast ads remain. Keeps original selection when no direct stream is available.

patches.name: SBS playback compatibility check
patches.description: Checks SBS TV 6.3.1 playback integration points. Does not remove advertisements.
